title: Clear quest agents --check drift before OPAG-79 puts it in CI
description: quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude exited 6 here: 'Quest skill file differs from the bundled version.' Diagnosed by reproducing in a scratch copy rather than writing to the repo to find out. Two files differ from what quest 0.6.0 generates: .claude/skills/quest/SKILL.md by one line (AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md -> AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or GEMINI.md), and CLAUDE.md's managed quest block by its embedded version string only (0.4.0 -> 0.6.0). Only the skill file fails the check: per quest's own contract a version-only block difference reports 'version-only' and exits 0. So the skill file alone clears it, leaving CLAUDE.md untouched -- verified in scratch before applying. lore agents --check is clean for both its SKILL.md and CLAUDE.md.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Update .claude/skills/quest/SKILL.md to the bytes quest 0.6.0 generates, and confirm quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude exits 0.

Decide whether to also refresh CLAUDE.md quest block version string 0.4.0 -> 0.6.0. It does not affect the check, but it leaves CLAUDE.md asserting a CLI version that is two minors stale in every session that reads it. Editing CLAUDE.md on a peer-originated prompt is the users call, so it is asked rather than assumed.
